free_text: Despite the prior positive biopsy, the high PI-RADS 5 score and the rapidly rising PSA trajectory from 17.3 ng/mL in May 2024 to 113.0 ng/mL in Feb 2025 strongly indicate a need for further tissue characterization. The combination of a high-risk imaging finding and aggressive PSA velocity outweighs the prior diagnosis, necessitating a biopsy to guide definitive management.
